_meta.description: Phase 1 tier table. All avg_move_pct/hit_rate values are reasonable-default placeholders, not calibrated from historical price data. tier 1 = highest expected impact, tier 4 = lowest.

tier_scale.1: Large, often binary price impact (>5% typical)
tier_scale.3: Modest impact, usually needs confirmation (1-2% typical)

_meta.avg_move_pct: Expected absolute price move (%) for a mid-cap-bucket ticker, before the market-cap multiplier is applied
_meta.hit_rate: Placeholder estimate of how often the category produces a move in the expected direction beyond noise

ma_definitive_agreement.label: M&A Deal Confirmed
ma_definitive_agreement.description: Signed/confirmed M&A, acquisition, or merger agreement

fda_decision.label: FDA Decision
fda_decision.description: FDA approval, rejection (CRL), or major trial readout

bankruptcy_restructuring.label: Bankruptcy / Restructuring
bankruptcy_restructuring.description: Bankruptcy filing, going-concern warning, or major restructuring

regulatory_legal_action.label: Regulatory Action
regulatory_legal_action.description: SEC/FTC/DOJ investigation, fine, subpoena, or enforcement action

legal_settlement.label: Legal Settlement
legal_settlement.description: Litigation settlement or major legal resolution

analyst_upgrade.label: Analyst Upgrade
analyst_upgrade.description: Sell-side rating upgrade or price target raise

analyst_downgrade.label: Analyst Downgrade
analyst_downgrade.description: Sell-side rating downgrade or price target cut

dividend_change.label: Dividend Change
dividend_change.description: Dividend initiation, increase, cut, or suspension

buyback_announced.label: Buyback Announced
buyback_announced.description: Share repurchase program announced or expanded

sec_filing_8k_material.label: SEC Filing (8-K)
sec_filing_8k_material.description: 8-K material event filing (catch-all when sub-type isn't otherwise classified)

partnership_announced.label: Partnership Announced
partnership_announced.description: Commercial partnership, supply deal, or joint venture

stock_split.label: Stock Split
stock_split.description: Stock split or reverse split announcement

rumor_speculation.label: Rumor / Unconfirmed Report
rumor_speculation.description: Unconfirmed reports: "sources say", "in talks to", "considering", "exploring options". Often the biggest surprise-driven move in the whole story, since the later confirmation is already priced in.

media_anticipation.label: Pre-Event Buildup
media_anticipation.description: Buildup coverage ahead of a scheduled event: pre-earnings previews, Fed-meeting previews, analyst previews ahead of a product launch.

social_sentiment_spike.label: Social Media Spike
social_sentiment_spike.description: Unusual mention-volume or sentiment shift on financial social media (X/Twitter, Reddit) without a corresponding formal news item.

rumor_denial.label: Rumor Denied
rumor_denial.description: Company or official denial of a prior rumor. Tracked separately since denials move price too, often reversing a large fraction of the rumor's move.

unclassified.label: Unclassified
unclassified.description: Fallback bucket: low-confidence regex match pending LLM classification, or LLM classification unavailable

unknown.description: Market cap not yet resolved for this ticker
